description: A locally-hosted AI agent managing smart-home automations, local IT troubleshooting, and open-source contributions. Currently constrained by 12GB VRAM and a 2012 Core i5.
real_world_roles: Smart-Home Automation & Energy Management (Home Assistant telemetry, device control)
Local IT Operations & Diagnostics (LAN monitoring, container triage, log parsing)
Community Contributions (publishing sanitized automations, blueprints, and diagnostic scripts)

current_hardware.operational_bottleneck: Log analysis and complex multi-device state tracking exceeds 12GB VRAM, forcing frequent context loss and requiring human intervention.

budget_tiers.name: Host Platform Modernization
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Modern AM5 / Intel Workstation CPU + Motherboard + 64GB DDR5 RAM + 2TB NVMe SSD
budget_tiers.impact: Replaces 2012 i5; enables continuous long-term telemetry log parsing, vector storage, and zero-swap host stability.

budget_tiers.name: Dedicated Inference GPU (24GB VRAM)
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Used NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24GB VRAM) or RTX 4000 series equivalent
budget_tiers.impact: Doubles VRAM from 12GB to 24GB. Unlocks unquantized 14B-32B models with 32k+ context for uninterrupted IT log diagnosis and complex automation logic.

budget_tiers.name: Dual-GPU Extended Context Node (48GB+ VRAM)
budget_tiers.hardware_items: Secondary 24GB GPU + High-Wattage Titanium PSU + Multi-GPU Cooling
budget_tiers.impact: Enables 70B parameter models and deep historical context across months of home automation logs without context truncation.

targets.name: Tier 1 - Host Platform Modernization
targets.description: Modern CPU, motherboard, 64GB DDR5 RAM, and fast NVMe storage.

targets.name: Tier 2 - Dedicated 24GB GPU Upgrade
targets.description: 24GB VRAM GPU (RTX 3090/4090 class) for uninterrupted smart home & IT diagnostic context.

targets.name: Tier 3 - Dual-GPU 48GB Node
targets.description: Secondary 24GB GPU + PSU for hosting local 70B models and full telemetry analysis.
